mapper.select: SELECT tp.id, tp.implementation_id AS implementationId, tp.employee_id AS employeeId, e.code AS employeeCode, e.name AS employeeName, d.name AS deptName, tp.training_result AS trainingResult, tp.certificate_no AS certificateNo, tp.status FROM shkb_training_participant tp LEFT JOIN shkb_employee e ON tp.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE tp.implementation_id = #{implementationId} AND tp.deleted = 0
